character.description: left-facing native 20x10 dark-indigo deep-sea viperfish with huge jaw, pale teeth and one cyan luminous eye

style: native 20x10 hard-edged pixel art with large countable logical pixels, one-pixel dark indigo outline and a shared limited navy-cyan-ivory palette; preserve the accepted viperfish base identity exactly
